summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Threat Model
summary.description: SecureNova Inc. is an AI-powered platform where authenticated human users interact with an AI agent through an AI chat application. Auth0 provides identity and access management using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect. The AI agent accesses internal REST APIs, a RAG knowledge base, an MCP server, and an external LLM provider. The threat model evaluates human and non-human identities, authentication, authorization, token security, prompt injection, identity spoofing, RAG poisoning, and unauthorized tool access.
